description.text: The construction of the original International Space Station was a milestone of humanity's earliest attempts at gaining a foothold into space. Sadly, it was destroyed during the early Turf Wars. This station was created as a monument to the original. While the exterior matches visual records of what the first I.S.S. looked like, the interior layout has replaced the science and research labs with a museum dedicated to the history of human space exploration.

spaceport.text: Many of the visitors are families or students on school field trips. The gift shop next to the docking ports sells various historically accurate models, science kits, and other knick-knacks meant to appeal to parents and teachers looking for something educational to bring home from their visit.
